title: Secrets
hook: 妈妈给 Peppa 做了一个秘密盒子，可 George 也有秘密，Peppa 就忍不住想知道。

cells.q: What did Mummy Pig make for Peppa?
cells.a: She made a special box for Peppa.
cells.cn: 她给 Peppa 做了一个特别的盒子。

cells.a: She said, “George, this is my secret box!”
cells.cn: 她说：“George，这是我的秘密盒子！”

cells.q: What did George want to know?
cells.a: He wanted to know what was inside the secret box.
cells.cn: 他想知道盒子里装了什么。

cells.a: No, he could not guess what was in the box.
cells.cn: 他猜不出来盒子里是什么。

cells.a: He asked, “Have you put my glasses inside?”
cells.cn: 他问：“你把我的眼镜放进去了吗？”

cells.q: What did Peppa want to know?
cells.a: She wanted to know what was inside George's box.
cells.cn: 她想知道 George 的盒子里有什么。

cells.q: How did Peppa feel about secrets?
cells.a: She did not like secrets as much as she used to.
cells.cn: 她不像以前那么喜欢秘密了。

cells.a: She asked, “Do you have any more secret things?”
cells.cn: 她问：“你还有别的秘密吗？”

cells.q: What did George say at the end?
cells.a: He said, “I don't have a special box.”
cells.cn: 他说：“我没有特别的盒子。”

helper.order: First / Next / Then / After that / Finally
helper.keywords: secret, box, special, inside, guess, glasses
helper.actions: make, hide, guess, open, ask, show

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “Secrets”.
ending: In the end, George says he does not have a special box. My favourite part is ______.
